title: In the following crossword puzzle, each clue is followed by a transcriber-assigned column letter and row number. Numbers in parentheses at the end of each clue indicate the number of letters in the puzzle word. The clue letter/number and number of letters in the word are enclosed in transcriber’s note indicators. In the grid, a hyphen represents a square to be filled in, and a full cell represents an empty space.

resolution: Both runs agreed on the quoted wording (verbatim from the rule text) but both independently mis-set illustrates.rule to the fixed placeholder "19.2.2" (the Linear Key Format rule) regardless of which rule's own "Sample:" text this actually is — the same error in both, since both are the same model; corrected here by re-reading the source directly at the given textLines, matching this rule id (already embedded in the file's own name, following the §15 gold precedent's naming convention).
